title: Fix Your Paycheck With the 3-Step 50/30/20 Rule
hook_text: STOP GUESSING WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES

beats.say: Stop guessing where your money goes. Here's how to fix a $3,000 paycheck in three steps.
beats.visual: A sleek minimalist desk with a blank notebook and a single pen under warm lamp light, top-down view

beats.say: Step one. Dedicate fifty percent for needs. On a $3,000 paycheck, that's $1,500 for rent, groceries, and bills.
beats.visual: A stack of plain white envelopes resting on a dark wooden table, cinematic shadows

beats.say: Lock these down first so your basic survival is covered without stress.
beats.visual: A shiny silver key resting beside a closed leather notebook, macro shot

beats.say: Step two. Allocate thirty percent for wants. That's $900 for dining out, hobbies, and streaming apps.
beats.visual: A ceramic coffee cup sitting on a rustic wooden counter next to a warm window blur

beats.say: You don't need to live like a monk. This money is yours to spend guilt-free.
beats.visual: A blurred city street at dusk seen through a cafe window with rain droplets

beats.say: Step three. Put twenty percent toward your future. That's $600 straight into savings and investments.
beats.visual: A clear glass jar sitting on a marble countertop with soft morning light filtering through

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions. Most people save what's left after spending.
beats.visual: An empty metallic bowl reflecting soft ambient light in a quiet room

beats.say: That's why they stay broke. You must pay your future self first before touching the rest.
beats.visual: A heavy steel vault door partially open, throwing long dramatic shadows across the floor

beats.say: Automate these exact transfers the day you get paid.
beats.visual: A finger pressing a sleek silver button on a minimalist desk gadget

beats.say: Do this today, because saving $500/month at 8% per year builds real wealth over time...
beats.visual: A vintage metal pocket watch ticking quietly on a stack of aged leather books

caption: The simple math to fix your paycheck starting today. Save this reel for payday. Follow for the money rules school never taught you. #personalfinance #budgeting #moneyhacks #wealthbuilding
description: Learn how to split a $3,000 paycheck using the 50/30/20 rule for needs, wants, and your future.
first_comment: What percentage of your paycheck usually goes toward your needs?

facts.claim: Investing $500/month at 8%/yr builds wealth over time
